official_definition: Bombardment-Zero (When Advents/Attacks) You can reveal one card from the top of your deck. When that card is a "Emperor Beast" family Spirit card, send one opposing Life to the Reserve. When it is a card with Advent, instead, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve. The revealed card is added to your hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Bombardment-Zero] or [Bombardment-Zero: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Bombardment-Zero]", "give [Bombardment-Zero]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
